name: Team & Delegation {OS}
tagline: Hand work off so it comes back right the first time.

commands.name: /delegate-pick
commands.summary: Split the load into a delegate list and a keep list, with a reason on each side.

commands.name: /delegate-match
commands.summary: Choose the person and the authority level, on evidence.

commands.name: /delegate-brief
commands.summary: Write the six required parts of a delegation brief.

commands.name: /delegate-confirm
commands.summary: Test that the brief landed by having the receiver restate it.

commands.name: /delegate-check
commands.summary: Run an agreed check-in: on course, corrected, or blocked.

commands.name: /delegate-receive
commands.summary: Judge returned work against the brief, and name any gap once, completely.

commands.name: /delegate-feedback
commands.summary: Write correction on an observable behaviour with a specific alternative.

commands.name: /delegate-level
commands.summary: Raise or lower authority on evidence, and say why.

commands.name: /delegate-recall
commands.summary: Take work back naming capacity, priority or fit, without a verdict on the person.

requires_human_approval_for: assigning work to a named person
changing someone's authority level, up or down
writing anything that records an individual's performance
committing someone else's time to an external deadline
escalating a person's repeated failure beyond the immediate working relationship
